style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the hermit crab works his whole body every beat; blank sheets and the gull fly at him; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat; the crab fills half the frame
character: the crab: small hermit crab, long eyestalks, one oversized claw, wearing a glossy pink ceramic piggy bank with a coin slot as his shell, no markings; ONE tiny octopus inspector in a plain peaked cap, no badge, lives inside it, until 6.5 only ONE eye blinking in the slot, tentacle in a white shirt cuff; ONE seagull inspector in a plain peaked cap, no badge
props: ONE piggy bank; blank sheets; furry mic bottom right
environment: low-tide beach, wet sand, hard sun, high exposure, camera low at sand level

audio.delivery: raspy small male voice, nervous, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mne ka-ZA-los', ya ot na-LO-go-voy PRYA-chus'. o-ka-ZA-los', shto o-NI u-ZHE DA-zhe v moy PAN-tsir' za-LEZ-li
audio.pacing: 0.35-6.5 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.5 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: sand spray, gull screech, paper flutter, ceramic knocks

timeline.a: the crab digs in with his legs, the whole pink piggy bank, snout and ears, sitting high above the sand, sand spraying; ONE eye blinks in the coin slot
the crab digs with his legs, sand spraying, the piggy bank stays on top, mouthparts opening on every syllable; ONE blank sheet whizzes across the lens
the crab ducks flat under the diving seagull, eyestalks snapping down, legs kicking sand, mouthparts opening on every syllable; the seagull dives across the frame and drops a burst of blank sheets
timeline.c: medium close, tilt up and back

timeline.a: the crab jerks his whole body around, eyestalks swinging back, mouthparts opening on every syllable; the eye in the slot blinks twice
timeline.c: close-up, whip tilt, crab and piggy bank slot in one frame

timeline.a: the crab rears up on his hind legs swatting both claws at a second wave of blank sheets whizzing by camera, body lurching left and right, mouthparts opening on every syllable
timeline.c: medium close, handheld shake, short pull back

timeline.a: the crab twists sideways and raps his big claw on the piggy bank, rocking with each knock, mouthparts opening on every syllable
a tentacle in a white shirt cuff pokes out of the slot; the piggy bank tips over backward, the crab's legs flail in the air
timeline.c: medium close, low angle, dolly in

timeline.a: the crab tumbles out, pale soft curled tail end showing, scuttles backward; the octopus squeezes his capped head out of the slot
the octopus pulls ONE blank sheet out of the slot and holds it out with a tentacle; the crab pinches it with his big claw
the crab drapes the sheet over his pale tail end like a shell, tucking the edges under with his claws
the crab hunched in the paper wrap shivers, shifts from leg to leg, tucks his eyestalks under it; the octopus slides back into the slot

must_appear: piggy bank shell 0.0, gull drop 1.4, tentacle 6.5, sheet as shell 8.3
negative_prompt: held mic, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 6.5, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, extra word, mouth shut, duplicate props, floating objects, crab running at the camera, markings on the piggy bank, text on sheets, far shot, night, cut, scene change
